title: Azure Metrics (mscs:metrics / mscs:metrics:events) events
description: Field schema for the Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services Azure Monitor metrics input, covering the standard event-index form and the Splunk metrics-index form (metric_index_flag=yes).

metricsEvent.title: Azure Metrics -- mscs:metrics / mscs:metrics:events
metricsEvent.description: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services Azure Monitor metrics event, sourcetype mscs:metrics or mscs:metrics:events (event-index format).

metricName.description: Name of the metric (e.g. Percentage CPU Available Memory Bytes)

resourceId / _ResourceId.description: Full ARM resource ID the metric belongs to

average.description: Average value of the metric in the time grain

minimum.description: Minimum value of the metric in the time grain

maximum.description: Maximum value of the metric in the time grain

total.description: Total/sum value of the metric in the time grain

count.description: Number of samples collected in the time grain

unit.description: Unit of the metric (e.g. Percent Bytes Count Seconds)

resourceGroup.description: Resource group name of the resource

resourceName.description: Name of the resource (parsed from resourceId when available)

resourceType.description: Type of the resource (parsed from resourceId when available)

metric_statistics.description: Requested statistic(s) configured in the input (Average Minimum Maximum Total Count)

dimensions{}.description: Dimension name-value pairs for multi-dimensional metrics (resource-specific)

metricsIndexEvent.title: Azure Metrics -- mscs:metrics (metric_index_flag=yes)
metricsIndexEvent.description: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services Azure Monitor metrics event written to a Splunk metrics index (sourcetype mscs:metrics with metric_index_flag=yes), adding the Splunk metrics-index-format fields (metric_name, _value, _dims) alongside the same resource-context fields as the event-index form.

metricName.description: Name of the metric (e.g. Percentage CPU Available Memory Bytes)

resourceId / _ResourceId.description: Full ARM resource ID the metric belongs to

average.description: Average value of the metric in the time grain

minimum.description: Minimum value of the metric in the time grain

maximum.description: Maximum value of the metric in the time grain

total.description: Total/sum value of the metric in the time grain

count.description: Number of samples collected in the time grain

unit.description: Unit of the metric (e.g. Percent Bytes Count Seconds)

resourceGroup.description: Resource group name of the resource

resourceName.description: Name of the resource (parsed from resourceId when available)

resourceType.description: Type of the resource (parsed from resourceId when available)

metric_statistics.description: Requested statistic(s) configured in the input (Average Minimum Maximum Total Count)

dimensions{}.description: Dimension name-value pairs for multi-dimensional metrics (resource-specific)

metric_name.description: Metric name in Splunk metrics index format (when metric_index_flag=yes)

_value.description: Metric value in Splunk metrics index format

_dims.description: Dimensions in Splunk metrics index format
